common.framework: plain PyTorch torch.nn.LSTM; no installation performed
common.future_covariates: actually issued and fully received before decision cutoff; never realized future weather
common.validation: two expanding chronological blocks; event groups kept intact; overlapping target windows purged
common.final_test: Dates frozen before outcomes. Final three refits use chosen config, development-derived fixed epoch count and eligible pre-test labels only; no final-test early stopping or seed selection.
common.baseline_tuning: Track all baseline choices too. Ridge penalty candidates [1,10,100] on same validation blocks; official/persistence/bias baselines deterministic. Do not silently expand search.
common.label_availability: Every fit uses only labels actually available by fit cutoff; retain declared original/revised vintages. Quarter-end is not a release date.
common.grid_decision_contract: Input receipt cutoff D12:00UTC; decision/processing deadline D12:05UTC; target intervals start D13:00 through D+1 12:00UTC inclusive, end D+1 13:00UTC. Skip if processing is late.

baseline_fit_budget.note: Deterministic operational/persistence/bias comparisons additional but no fitted-parameter search.

candidates.history_features: past observed load, lags of issued forecast errors, available weather and calendar; add renewables only under separate declared extension
candidates.future_features: issued load/weather forecast, lead and calendar at each future hour
candidates.head: final state concatenated with each future hour's known features -> Linear(16), ReLU -> scalar residual, shared across 24 hours
candidates.target: actual load minus unchanged selected operational forecast
candidates.next_stage: joint net-load / price-tail model only after separate data and forecast-semantics audit
gates: original forecast vintages and complete receipt times
candidates.output_hour_index_semantics: Values are target interval starts as hours since UTC midnight of decision date D, not lead hours from decision.

candidates.history_features: upstream and local stage/flow, available rain/temperature, missingness and age, known basin/gauge metadata
candidates.future_features: official river/weather forecasts issued by cutoff
candidates.head: direct residuals for days 1,3,7
candidates.target: observed stage minus official stage forecast
gates: stage threshold linked to actual navigation restriction
not a full rainfall-runoff or annual snow-memory model

candidates.reason: quarterly outcomes and dated exposures are scarce; weather rows cannot multiply independent earnings labels
